_provenance: GENERATED by tools/fuel_analytics.py (M337) from raw/ fuel columns, drive_master.csv, seasonal_drive_master.csv, raw_manifest.json. Do not hand-edit.
basis: logged/app-calculated fuel counter and rate (Car Scanner ELM OBD2); raw/ = sha256-verified originals (M366); not M299-reproducible
method: day-clustered percentile bootstrap (seed 42, 4000 draws), ratio-of-sums; day = trip start date; interval only with >=7 distinct days (5-6 low-cluster, <5 points only)

withoutFuelData.note: selection on a counter increment > 0 is resolution-driven and may bias short-trip band rates upward

reconciliation.eligibilityRule: ELIG-A (fuelContract): counter >=2 numeric with max>min AND rate any value >0; canonical-clean (ens_outlier_v2 not True), km>0

fuel12.definition: sum(V_int - V_cnt)/sum(V_cnt); positive = rate integral above counter; V_cnt = counter(last valid) - counter(first valid); V_int = rate integral on the rate's own valid sample times inside that window, each step using the time since the PREVIOUS valid rate sample (for the first in-window sample that sample may lie before the window), dt capped at 5 s

f03Sensitivity.note: not a paired test: the files that were never re-exports and the former re-exports (replaced by the sha256-verified originals, M366) are date-confounded; the read-only raw-vs-originals fuel check in analyses/M337_f03_fuel_check_result.md was run before the replacement

auditR9Reference.role: regression reference for the frozen audit data, not an acceptance tolerance

fuel12.stopRule: CI lower > +1% or CI upper < -1% or |point| > 1% of counter volume

reviewMargin.status: arbitrary review margin, fixed in advance; not a justified equivalence bound

fuel12.limits: both series come from the same app: agreement does not establish independence or external accuracy; an internal consistency check whose size and sign depend on the integration dt cap (5 s base, 2 s flips the sign); not a bias estimate

fuel01.eligibility: ELIG-A, no reset, km >= 0.5 (identical ids in both panels); trip fuel = counter delta; rate = 100*V/km
fuel01.limits: rates are not SoC-corrected (charge-sustaining balance) and SoC change confounds short trips; any fitted line would be descriptive, not a startup-fuel intercept

fuel11.weighting: tripWeighted = type-7 empirical quantile of trip L/100 km; distanceWeighted = lowest rate with cumulative km share >= q; recomputed on every day-resample
fuel11.limits: short-trip and thermal-composition drift can be misread as a change over time; composition annotations are per window; rates are not SoC-corrected
